{{dablink|For the sword form with a similar name, see [[The Boar Rushed Downhill]]. For other uses of the word "mountain," see [[Mountain]].}}
'''The Boar Rushes Down the Mountain''' is a [[sword form]]. It is a series of aggressive strikes raining down from overhead.{{ref/book|2|45}}

[[Rand al'Thor]] used this sword form against [[Turak Aladon]], forcing the [[Seanchan]] into retreating.{{ref/book|2|45}}

Rand also used this form to break through his sparring partner's [[Parting the Silk]] and [[Lightning of Three Prongs]].{{ref/book|6|1}}
